<div class="card-body">
'''Tatooine: Jundland Wastes''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：ジャンドラントの荒野</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ライトサイド：戦闘運命数を引くのに必要な能力値が６以上になる。ダークサイド：自分のタスケン・レイダーは没収値＋１。支配しているなら、フォース消耗に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-293o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja"></span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tatooine: Jundland Wastes.

'''Card text:''' Light Side: The ability required to draw battle destiny increases to 6 or more. Dark Side: Your Tusken Raiders are forfeit +1. If you control, add 1 to the Force drain.

'''Lore:''' 

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names タスケン・レイダー for Tusken Raiders.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tatooine: Jundland Wastes]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100.
